recipe.criteria: Static forearm plank, closed fists and close feet. Whole-body contraction and isometric elbow-to-toe pull are coached in text; muscle tension cannot be demonstrated by pose alone. Eight-second illustrative hold, no entry or exit.
limitations: Procedural demonstration; support samples are not full collision or biomechanical certification.
Timing is illustrative. Holds show the maintained position only; entry and exit are not animated.
